name: manley-vari-mu-parallel-smash
description: NY parallel smash via the UADx Manley Variable Mu's built-in MIX: crush a hot wet, blend the dry back. DUAL INPUT 8 (drive the tubes), threshold 2, ATTACK 8 (fast clamp), RECOVERY 'Fast', LIMIT mode (much more GR than Comp), HP SIDECHAIN 'Flat', MIX 45 so the dry transients stay. Bigger/denser with the attack preserved. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus: +0.61 LU, crest 17.17->16.59, low-band punch 27.15->25.99 (denser low end), LRA 2.30, true-peak -0.98 — the dry blend keeps the slam.
intended_for: a drum bus / room / parallel aux that wants size + density with the dry punch intact
plugin_build: uaudio_manley_variable_mu.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the /Components/UAD Manley Variable Mu.component twin passes through offline, do not use it).
notes: MIX is built-in parallel (100 = fully wet). As MIX drops, the dry transients return and crest recovers — measured: mix100 crest 16.00 -> mix25 crest 16.60 on a hard wet. ~40-50% keeps slam.
LIMIT mode pulls much more level than COMP at the same threshold (thr4: -5.8 vs -2.2 dB) — it's the higher-ratio mode. Pair with fast ATTACK + Fast RECOVERY for the densest wet.
Drive DUAL INPUT up (8-10) to hit the tubes for even-harmonic color on the wet; the dry blend keeps it from sounding distorted.
